title: Home-Site Lease Autopay: Enrollment, Cancellation and the Monthly Discount
content:
**Autopay terms for Home-Site Lease residents**

Enrolling in or cancelling autopay is the resident's own authorization of ACH debits from their bank account, and it is recorded only on the resident's instruction.

- Autopay can be enrolled only while the lease is active or notice to vacate.
- Autopay cannot be enrolled while the lease is on certified-funds-only status.
- The lot class's autopay discount is credited for a billing period only when the enrollment was completed at least the lot class's cutoff in calendar days before that period's rent due day **and** the period's rent was drafted by autopay. An enrollment completed later first earns the discount in the following billing period.
- No autopay discount is credited for a prorated month, for any period inside the lot class's withholding length after a returned autopay draft, or for a period in which autopay was cancelled before the draft.
- A cancellation takes effect on the day it is received.

Both the lease status and the payment restriction are read from the lease record.

**Enrollment conditions**

| Lease status | Certified-funds-only status | Enrollment |
|---|---|---|
| active | no | may be enrolled |
| notice to vacate | no | may be enrolled |
| active or notice to vacate | yes | cannot be enrolled |
| applied, approved, in default, closed or denied | — | cannot be enrolled |

**Discount for one billing period**

| Enrollment completed in time and rent drafted by autopay | Prorated month, inside a withholding period, or cancelled before the draft | Discount for that period |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | credited |
| yes | yes | not credited |
| no | — | not credited |

**Boundary (hypothetical, cutoff of five days, rent due on the 1st)** — an enrollment completed five calendar days before the 1st earns the discount for that month; one completed four days before first earns it in the following month.
